text: **Hint 1:** Consider the shape of the scatterplot. Does it resemble any common mathematical function, such as a linear, quadratic, or absolute value function? This can help determine which function f(x) might fit the data.\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the properties of the absolute value function, |x|. It creates a V-shaped graph. Does the scatterplot in question (iv) resemble this shape? If so, it might be possible to fit the data using f(x) $$=$$ |x|.
